articles.title: Jane Kaczmarek on Malcolm in the Middle, The Boroughs, and Finding the Hotness in a Second Act: Podcast
articles.summary: Actress Jane Kaczmarek, famed for "Malcolm in the Middle," is featured in an interview with Kyle Meredith, discussing her return to the series after 20 years. She also elaborates on her involvement with the Duffer Brothers, known for "Stranger Things." The discussion offers insights into her recent career resurgence and upcoming entertainment projects, providing an update on her contributions to the entertainment industry.

articles.title: Russia’s top banker begs for Putin end to Ukraine war, issues stark warning: ‘Economy simply cannot survive’
articles.summary: Russia's top banker, German Gref, has urged President Vladimir Putin to end the Ukraine war, warning that the prolonged conflict is dragging the country towards economic collapse. Gref, a prominent state-controlled bank head, highlighted the severe financial strain on Russia. This reflects growing internal pressure regarding the immense long-term economic costs of Russia's military involvement.

articles.title: Japanese Submarines Have Now Sunk The US Navy’s ‘USS Juneau’ Twice
articles.summary: A Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force submarine successfully fired a torpedo at the decommissioned USS Juneau, sinking it during a live-fire exercise (SINKEX). This event was a key component of the multinational Valiant Shield 2026 exercise. The drill showcased advanced maritime capabilities and interoperability between Japan and the US, enhancing joint combat readiness in the Pacific region.
